200.description: Holdings, largest first. Values are in the workspace base currency.

asset.description: A raw, un-matched asset descriptor used inside transaction asset legs.

type.description: Asset class. Used to drive matching and tax treatment.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the asset lives on.

contractAddress.description: Token contract address (for on-chain tokens / NFTs).

asset.title: RawAsset

allocationPercentage.description: Asset-wide allocation (wallet value / total asset value), sorted descending.

costPerUnit.description: Average cost per unit (costBasis / totalQuantity). 0 when no cost basis.

roiPercentage.description: ROI as a percentage of cost basis. null when cost basis is 0 — distinguishes 'no basis' from '0% return'.

isSpam.description: Marked as spam by user or global spam list.

transactionCount.description: Workspace-wide count of transactions touching this asset.

totalValue.description: Value of every holding, before search or paging.
